description: What share of Chinese companies' AI accelerator spending will go to domestic suppliers over the 12 months following July 2026, versus the 46% planned in the Bloomberg Intelligence survey?
outcome: The realized share of Chinese enterprises' AI accelerator budget captured by domestic suppliers (Huawei, Hygon, Cambricon and others) over the 12 months from mid-2026, measured against the 46% planned and the 30% current level.
period: The 12 months from the survey's release on 2026-07-07 (to mid-2027); settled when follow-up survey or market-share data covering that period are published.
reply:
It tracks one quantity: the share of Chinese enterprises' AI-accelerator budgets that actually goes to domestic suppliers (Huawei, Hygon, Cambricon) over the 12 months from the survey's 2026-07-07 release to mid-2027 — the 46% planned, against the 30% current baseline. Settled by a follow-up Bloomberg Intelligence survey or third-party China accelerator shipment/share data covering that window.

Instructions applied: outcome = "the period or check date that settles the thesis"; period = "A shared quantity takes its release date," with "settled_by" naming "the public material that will settle the answer on a date."

Alternatives I considered: (a) `opens_as: policy_stage`, rejected — no named regulator's decision; (b) a fixed check date around mid-2027, rejected because the item gives no release calendar for a follow-up survey, so naming one would invent it; (c) wording tracking "Nvidia's China market share" instead, rejected — the survey's quantitative figure is domestic-supplier budget share, and Nvidia share would duplicate clean-4's scope.
